memories.content: The council is aware that a first reading of the short-term-rental ordinance has occurred. The council has a scheduled August recess beginning on a date known to them. They must hold a second reading before that recess begins. Individual council members may have varying opinions on the ordinance.

The Riverton city council has a short-term-rental ordinance that requires a second reading before it can be adopted. The council's August recess is scheduled to begin on a specific date, which is before the hard cutoff of 2026-08-14T17:00:00-06:00. The council has the authority to schedule meetings and readings. The exact date of the recess start is known to the council but not specified here.
